ECORE-JS-Validation-UI

By Edward Margallo

Find form errors faster

This demo adds an error count to a long form and scrolls to the first invalid field. After a field is corrected, the count updates and the next error is brought into view.

Submit the form to see the validation summary. Required fields are intentionally left empty.
